t: A guide for programming the Circuit Playground Express with EduBlocks.
steps: Obtain a Circuit Playground Express and a micro USB cable.
Install CircuitPython by dragging a .uf2 file to the board.
Open the EduBlocks editor in a browser.
Build the blinking LED program from the first lesson.
Download main.py and copy it to the CIRCUITPY drive.
Avoid importing both the CPX Easy and NeoPixel libraries. It causes a pin in use error.
Test Chromebook use before you plan a class around it.
